appDesc.message: Guarda imágenes con clic, arrastre o descarga masiva.

disableDragLabel.description: Label for the checkbox to turn off drag-to-save.

popupSelect.description: Button label for toggling a checkbox on an image cell.

popupDownload.description: Action button tooltip for downloading a specific image.

popupNoMedia.message: No se encontraron imágenes ni videos

popupSelected.description: Noun following the count of selected images (e.g., '3 selected').

popupReload.message: Recarga la página e inténtalo de nuevo

popupMediaFallback.description: Fallback name for an image/video when the URL has no filename.

popupDerivedBadge.description: Badge aria-label indicating an image was generated from an inline SVG.

popupDerivedBadgeText.description: Short visible badge text indicating an image is an SVG.

popupEmptyHint.message: Consejo: Alt+Clic o arrastre imágenes para guardar

popupInlineSvg.description: Filename shown in the cell label for a captured inline SVG. Must match the real download filename in background.js — do not translate.

popupHiddenCount.description: Message showing the number of smaller duplicate images collapsed from the UI.

popupShortcutHint.description: Instructions on keyboard shortcuts shown in button tooltips.
